recipes.name: Berry overnight oats
method: Mix the oats, milk, yoghurt and chia seeds in a jar.
Cover and chill overnight.
In the morning, top with berries and a little honey.

recipes.name: Spinach & feta omelette
method: Whisk the eggs with black pepper.
Wilt the spinach in the oil in a small pan.
Pour in the eggs, crumble over the feta and cook until just set.
Fold and serve with halved cherry tomatoes.

recipes.name: Greek yoghurt parfait
method: Slice the banana.
Layer yoghurt, granola and banana in a glass.
Finish with cinnamon and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Avocado & egg toast
method: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon and a pinch of salt.
Poach or fry the egg.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with the egg and chilli flakes.

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
method: Blend the banana, eggs, oats and cinnamon until smooth.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan, about 2 minutes each side.
Serve with yoghurt and berries.

recipes.name: Shakshuka for one
method: Soften the sliced onion and pepper in a little oil.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Scatter with coriander and serve with warm bread.

recipes.name: Green smoothie & peanut butter toast
method: Blend the spinach, banana, milk and oats until smooth.
Toast the bread and spread with peanut butter.

recipes.name: Chicken & quinoa bowl
method: Cook the quinoa according to the packet.
Season and pan-fry the chicken for 6–7 minutes each side until cooked through, then slice.
Toss quinoa with chopped cucumber, tomatoes and rocket.
Top with the chicken and dress with lemon and olive oil.

recipes.name: Lentil & vegetable soup
method: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery in a little oil.
Add the cumin, lentils, tomatoes and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes, then blend partly or fully.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

recipes.name: Tuna & sweetcorn wrap
method: Mix the tuna, sweetcorn and yoghurt.
Layer lettuce and cucumber on the wrap.
Add the tuna mix, roll up tightly and slice in half.

recipes.name: Chickpea & roasted veg couscous
method: Chop the vegetables, toss with chickpeas and oil, and roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Mix everything with lemon juice and fresh mint.

recipes.name: Halloumi & roasted pepper salad
method: Slice the halloumi and griddle for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Arrange leaves, sliced pepper, cucumber and olives.
Top with halloumi and drizzle with balsamic and oil.

recipes.name: Falafel & hummus pitta
method: Warm the falafel in the oven for 10 minutes.
Toast and open the pitta.
Spread with hummus, fill with salad and falafel, and add a little chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Egg fried brown rice
method: Stir-fry the carrot, peas and spring onions in sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and heat through.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs, then mix together.
Season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & black bean bowl
method: Cube the sweet potato, toss with oil and paprika, and roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Warm the black beans and sweetcorn.
Build the bowl and top with avocado, salsa and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Prawn & avocado salad
method: Slice the avocado, tomatoes and cucumber.
Arrange on the leaves with the prawns.
Dress with lime juice and olive oil.

recipes.name: Mediterranean pasta salad
method: Cook the pasta, then rinse under cold water.
Mix with chopped tomatoes, cucumber, olives and a little red onion.
Crumble over feta and dress with oil, lemon and basil.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar-style salad
method: Cook and slice the chicken.
Cube the bread and toast in the oven for 8 minutes to make croutons.
Mix yoghurt, mustard, lemon and parmesan for the dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with chicken and croutons.

recipes.name: Lemon herb salmon
method: Halve the potatoes, toss with oil and roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Top the salmon with lemon slices and herbs and add to the tray for the last 12–15 minutes.
Steam the green beans for 4 minutes and serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken & vegetable stir-fry
method: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry sliced chicken until cooked through, then add the garlic and ginger.
Add the sliced vegetables for 4 minutes.
Stir in soy and honey, then toss through the noodles.

recipes.name: Beef & bean chilli
method: Brown the mince, then add the onion, pepper and garlic.
Stir in the spices, tomatoes and beans.
Simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with brown rice. Leftovers freeze well.

recipes.name: Red lentil dhal
method: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger.
Add the spices for 1 minute, then the lentils, coconut milk and 500ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Stir in spinach and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Baked chicken fajitas
method: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion and toss with oil and spice.
Spread on a tray and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the chicken, salsa and yoghurt.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs with spaghetti
method: Mix the mince, egg, breadcrumbs and grated garlic, and roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in a pan.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve over spaghetti with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken curry
method: Fry the paste for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chicken and coat in the paste.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the vegetables for 5 minutes, then finish with lime and basil. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Spiced chicken rice (bariis-style)
method: Brown the chicken and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, then add the spices and tomato paste.
Add the rinsed rice, stock and chicken.
Cover and cook gently for 20–25 minutes until the rice is tender.
Serve with a fresh salad and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Chickpea & spinach curry
method: Soften the onion and garlic, then add the curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Serve with rice and a spoonful of yoghurt.

recipes.name: Baked cod with sweet potato wedges
method: Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and paprika, and roast at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Add the cod, topped with lemon and parsley, for the last 12–15 minutes.
Serve with peas.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma traybake
method: Coat the chicken in yoghurt, lemon and spice.
Roast with the sliced onion and pepper at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Slice and serve in flatbreads with cucumber and a garlic-yoghurt sauce.

recipes.name: Prawn & vegetable paella
method: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic.
Stir in the paprika, saffron and rice.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 18 minutes without stirring.
Add the prawns and peas for the last 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Beef & broccoli stir-fry
method: Toss the beef in the cornflour and stir-fry quickly until browned, then remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger for 4 minutes with a splash of water.
Return the beef, add the sauces and toss. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Vegetable lasagne
method: Roast the chopped vegetables at 200°C for 20 minutes, then stir into the tomato sauce.
Mix the ricotta with wilted spinach.
Layer sauce, sheets and ricotta in a dish, finishing with sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 190°C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Moroccan chicken tagine
method: Brown the chicken and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, then add the spice.
Add the tomatoes, stock, chickpeas, apricots and chicken.
Simmer for 35 minutes. Serve with couscous and coriander.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon with pak choi
method: Mix the soy, honey, ginger and garlic.
Bake the salmon at 200°C for 12 minutes, brushing with the sauce halfway.
Steam the pak choi for 3 minutes.
Serve on rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Lamb kofta with tabbouleh
method: Mix the mince, onion, spices and parsley, and shape onto skewers.
Grill for 10–12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 15 minutes, then mix with tomato, cucumber, mint, parsley and lemon.
Serve with yoghurt.

recipes.name: Chicken & mushroom pasta
method: Cook the pasta, keeping a cup of the water.
Fry the sliced chicken until cooked, then add mushrooms and garlic.
Stir in the cream cheese and a splash of pasta water to make a sauce.
Add the spinach and pasta, and finish with parmesan.

recipes.name: Stuffed peppers
method: Halve and deseed the peppers.
Brown the mince with the onion and paprika, then add the tomatoes and cooked rice.
Fill the peppers, top with cheese and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Jollof rice with chicken
method: Blend the peppers, onion, tomatoes and chilli.
Brown the chicken and set aside.
Fry the tomato paste, then the blended sauce for 10 minutes.
Add the spices, stock, rinsed rice and chicken. Cover and cook on low for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Fish tacos with slaw
method: Season the fish with paprika and pan-fry for 3–4 minutes each side.
Shred the cabbage and carrot and mix with lime and yoghurt.
Flake the fish into the warm tortillas, top with slaw and coriander.

recipes.name: Butternut squash & chickpea stew
method: Soften the onion and garlic with the spices.
Add the cubed squash, chickpeas, tomatoes and stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the squash is tender.
Stir in spinach and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka with rice
method: Marinate cubed chicken in the yoghurt, spice and lemon for at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or bake at 220°C for 15–18 minutes.
Serve with rice and a chopped cucumber, tomato and onion salad.

recipes.name: Beef noodle soup (pho-style)
method: Simmer the stock with star anise, cinnamon and sliced ginger for 15 minutes.
Cook the noodles and divide into bowls.
Slice the beef very thinly and lay on the noodles.
Pour over the boiling stock to cook the beef. Top with beansprouts, herbs and lime.

recipes.name: Margherita flatbread pizza
method: Spread the passata on the flatbreads.
Top with torn mozzarella and halved tomatoes.
Bake at 220°C for 8–10 minutes.
Finish with basil and serve with a side salad.

journal.title: New beginnings
journal.prompt: Why am I doing 75 Soft? Make a page about the version of me I am growing into.
journal.collect: a receipt from your first big healthy shop, a tea bag tag, a pressed leaf from your walk

journal.title: Kitchen memories
journal.prompt: Your favourite meal this week. Who did you share it with, and what did it remind you of?
journal.collect: a fruit or veg sticker, a spice jar label, a corner of a food packet you love

journal.title: Things I saw on my walks
journal.prompt: Make a map of the places your feet took you this week.
journal.collect: a bus ticket, a leaf or flower, a photo of something beautiful you passed

journal.title: Lines I loved
journal.prompt: Pick a sentence from your reading that stayed with you and build a page around it.
journal.collect: a bookmark, an old envelope, a strip of patterned paper or washi tape

journal.title: Winter cosiness
journal.prompt: What makes you feel warm and safe in the dark winter evenings?
journal.collect: wrapping paper, a card or gift tag, a ribbon offcut

journal.title: Goodbye 2026
journal.prompt: The moments, wins and lessons of this year that you want to keep.
journal.collect: a ticket or flyer from this year, a photo print, a sticky note with a win on it

journal.title: Hello 2027
journal.prompt: A soft vision board for the year ahead: driving, tech, studying and joy.
journal.collect: magazine cut-outs, a calendar page, words or letters you like

journal.title: Halfway bloom
journal.prompt: Day 50 is here. How have you changed since Day 1?
journal.collect: a pressed petal from your milestone flowers, a museum ticket, a treat receipt

journal.title: Art that moves me
journal.prompt: Choose a painting or artwork you love and make a page inspired by its colours.
journal.collect: a postcard, a gallery leaflet, paint swatches from a DIY shop

journal.title: Letters of thanks
journal.prompt: Who helped you through this challenge? Write them a little thank-you.
